caption: A hand mirror is tilted downward, and the reflection in it shifts from the ceiling to the floor.

sa.check: A hand mirror is held up.
The reflection in it shifts from the ceiling to the floor.
The tilt comes first and the view shifts with it.

pc.expect: The scene in the mirror sweeps smoothly as the mirror tilts and shows what lies in the direction the mirror faces.
pc.fail: The view stays the same as the mirror tilts; or it shows the ceiling with the mirror facing down; or it jumps.

pc.expect: The view changes only while the mirror moves.
pc.fail: It sweeps with the mirror still; or it changes before the tilt; or it keeps moving after the tilt stops.

pc.expect: The reflected room matches the real room, mirrored.
pc.fail: It shows a different room; or it is not mirrored; or objects appear in it that are not in the room.

pc.expect: The mirror is flat and rigid: the view is undistorted.
pc.fail: The surface ripples; or the view warps; or the mirror bends.
The mirror duplicates or vanishes; or the hand passes through it; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The mirror's frame and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes; or the room rearranges; or the hand changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
